name: sit-up
phone: On the floor or a low stand, 2 to 3 metres away, side-on, the whole body in the picture, lying along it.
lastRep: may end at the far end

ready.from: Lying back: the trunk within 30 degrees of lying flat, or further back on a decline bench (the usual definition; not fitted).

Lying back, not bent forward on the feet (the trunk's lean is the same both ways): the thighs lie along the floor or are raised, within 20 degrees of level or above it (not fitted). Measured on Kd's videos (52c-ii): lying for a sit-up, the thighs read 83 to 176 degrees from hanging; bent forward in a deadlift, Romanian deadlift, good morning or swing, 10 to 44.

Lying down, not held up level on the shoulders and feet as at the top of a hip thrust (trunk and thighs read alike): the shins 20 degrees or more from hanging (not fitted). Kd's videos (52c-ii): lying for a sit-up 28 to 90; at the top of a hip thrust 0 to 11, where the phone's reading of a man sliding off the bench counted a sit-up.

rules.name: depth

standard.source: Kd's research file, "Decline Sit-Up": a decline crunch curls the trunk about 30 to 45 degrees, and a full sit-up comes up to about 80 to 90 degrees from the bench ("Weight-Plate Weighted Sit-Up": until the torso is near vertical). A sit-up is counted once the trunk has come up past the crunch's whole range.

rules.unseen: Keep your whole body in view.
rules.from: Set by movement-check from the form standard, 45 (its source beside it, which says why it takes no room of its own), used as it is; rounded the forgiving way. The people's shallowest rep reads 59.57.

rules.name: thighs stay
rules.from: Set by movement-check from 5 people's videos (scripts/movementVideos.ts), as filmed and as each replay that sets numbers (scripts/replays.ts), 118 reps: beyond the furthest rep by half its distance from the middle rep (39.66; standing 0).

rules.name: hips stay down
rules.from: Set by movement-check from 5 people's videos (scripts/movementVideos.ts), as filmed and as each replay that sets numbers (scripts/replays.ts), 118 reps: beyond the furthest rep by half its distance from the middle rep (0.16; standing 0).
